title: Publish a typed task constructor
prompt: The supplied model.ts exports the type Task with id and title fields. Import this type and export makeTask(id: number, title: string): Task. Return exactly those two fields.
hints: Read the type declaration in model.ts.
Keep the named function or value visible to other files.
Build the return object from the two parameters.
typeChecks: __Equal<typeof answer.makeTask, (id: number, title: string) => { id: number; title: string }>
feedback: Read the type declaration in model.ts.
